subject: Portfolio consolidation: multi-year ramp & co-terming playbook
messages:
From: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@atelia.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@atelia.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Portfolio consolidation: multi-year ramp & co-terming playbook

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the call earlier this week — appreciate you walking through the Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs. We spoke internally and have two asks we want to fold into renewal discussions for our six accounts:

1) Consolidate the six existing contracts into a single portfolio agreement on a co-term (calendar-fiscal alignment is fine).
2) Move to a multi-year arrangement (24 months preferred) with a staged ramp (25%/35%/40% token commit by year) and a clear burst path for Q4 and product launches.

From procurement perspective we also need: mid-term prorated billing for any seat-level adjustments, an auto-renew opt-in with a 60-day opt-out window, and an explicit SLA credit formula if latency/backpressure exceeds targets during launches.

Can Redwood provide a template playbook (MAP) that lays out 1) sequencing to co-term, 2) prorate rules, 3) burst/elasticity pricing, and 4) a proposed discount ladder for the 24-month term?

We'd like to get a firm commercial posture and a draft that we can send to legal by end of next week.

Attaching a short org/back-of-the-envelope usage forecast for your planning.

Thanks,
Jordan Myers
Head of Platform Ops
Atelia AI

Attachments: Atelia-Forecast-Nov2026.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@atelia.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Portfolio consolidation: multi-year ramp & co-terming playbook

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. This is exactly the sort of renewal we like to structure as a single playbook so ops + procurement have a predictable runway. I've sketched three practical options below (high-level commercial posture + operational checkpoints). Please review and tell us which you prefer — we can convert the chosen option into a MAP and a DocuSign-ready term amendment.

Option A — Phased onramp (Conservative)- 12-month base term, option to extend to 24 months at year 1 pricing; staged ramp of 30/35/35; no upfront prepay; credits for missed SLOs; burst capacity billed at defined per-minute rate.

Option B — Co-term Multi-year (Recommended)- 24-month committed term, co-term for all portfolios aligned to calendar FY; ramp schedule 25% first 6 months / 35% months 7–15 / 40% final 9 months; 10% implementation credit (applied as first-quarter invoice credit); prorated mid-term seat changes per standard prorate table; auto-renew enabled with 60-day opt-out; SLA credit schedule included.

Option C — Frontloaded Discount (Aggressive)- 24-month term with higher discount but frontloaded prepay equivalent to 6 months; burst safety net included; strict usage true-up every quarter.

Operational notes (applies to all options):
- We will define burst shedding and fallback variants (smaller model families) for high-traffic launches to protect latencies.
- We propose a 30-day mutual action plan for legal/finance review items; Marissa, can you take point on draft amendment and pricing sheet?
- Karthik, I'll need a Canary plan with fallback models + an ops runbook stub to include in the MAP.

Next steps: Jordan, pick A/B/C by EOD Wednesday and we'll produce the MAP + one-page amendment. If you want, we can include a 30% credit cap for SLA failures for launches at no additional charge as a one-time concession.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive — Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (I will follow up with a draft MAP and a proposed amendment)

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@atelia.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@atelia.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Portfolio consolidation: multi-year ramp & co-terming playbook

Mina / team — thanks, that framing is helpful. After internal alignment we prefer Option B (Co-term Multi-year). A few clarifications before we move to legal:

1) Billing/prorate: We expect clear examples for mid-term seat adds/removals (show a sample invoice calculation).
2) SLA credits: we need the formula to be explicit (minutes of violation * SLA rate) and an annual cap; also want a runbook for how incidents are measured.
3) Burst: for product launches we may exceed the committed tokens by 3x for short windows; we'd like an agreed burst bucket that can be consumed before metered pricing kicks in.

If we can get those three items in the MAP, procurement can sign off and loop in legal. Please include a DocuSign-ready amendment and the DocuSign envelope link in the next email.

Thanks — Priya Singh
Senior Procurement Manager
Atelia AI
procurement@atelia.ai

Attachments: Atelia-usage-highlights.pdf (doc stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@atelia.ai>, Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@atelia.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 18:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Portfolio consolidation: multi-year ramp & co-terming playbook

Great — thanks Priya. We're aligned on Option B and will produce a MAP that includes:

- A prorate examples appendix (3 sample invoice scenarios)
- Explicit SLA credit formula and measurement points (we'll include monthly/annual caps and an incident measurement runbook)
- A "burst bucket" construct: an agreed short-term buffer (equal to 1.5x peak historical hour for 72 hours) that will be consumed before metered overage pricing applies; for launches that need additional capacity we can enable a temporary burst window with pre-agreed price tiers.

I've asked Marissa to produce the draft amendment + pricing sheet and to seed a DocuSign envelope. Marissa — can you attach the amendment (Atelia-MAP-draft-v2.pdf) and the DocuSign link in the shared drive? Karthik — please add the canary/fallback runbook section to the MAP and share the XLS tab with the burst math.

I'll follow up tomorrow with the DocuSign envelope and a 1-page summary for legal. Once signed we can convert the six contracts into the single co-term amendment and schedule an onboarding kickoff to operationalize the burst playbook.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive — Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Atelia-MAP-draft-v2.pdf (draft MAP), DocuSign-Envelope-AT-001.link (envelope stub)
